item.title: The NHS Alliance responds to IFS analysis on NHS budget top-ups
item.description: David Williams says analysis highlights the tension the NHS has been navigating between driving down waiting lists and staying within budget.

item.title: ADHD and autism costs running "out of control"
item.description: Rebecca Gray comments on the pressures local NHS leaders face as the cost of ADHD assessments and support mounts.

item.title: Welsh Government’s first 100 days: NHS leaders welcome collaboration and urge long-term action
item.description: Darren Hughes responds to the Welsh Government's delivery on their first 100 days plan.

item.title: Evidence that the NHS is moving in the right direction
item.description: David Williams responds to findings from the Care Quality Commission's annual hospital inpatients survey.

item.title: Pause zero-hours reforms over cost risk, warns NHS Employers
item.description: Sir Ciarán says current proposals risk landing the NHS with another unfunded cost at a time when cuts have already had to be made to budgets.

item.title: Taskforce calls on NHS organisations to adopt successful trainee scheme
item.description: Health leaders are being encouraged to support communications trainee schemes through a toolkit developed by South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust.

item.title: Heatwaves drive record-breaking demand on NHS Wales services, latest figures show
item.description: Darren Hughes responds to the NHS Wales activity and performance figures for June and July.

item.title: HSC leaders praise former NI Health Minister Nesbitt and call for urgent focus on Reset Plan
item.description: NICON members respond to the resignation of Mike Nesbitt as NI Health Minister after two years in office.

item.title: The NHS Alliance responds to HSSIB report on NHS advice and guidance services

item.description: Matthew Hopkins responds to the latest performance data from NHS England.

item.title: "Stretch targets" for mental health a significant step in the right direction
item.description: Alex Stewart responds to confirmation of “stretch targets” for mental health services.

item.title: New explainer shines spotlight on voluntary sector's vital role in Wales' health and care system
